name: event-schema-design
description: Design event schemas for event-driven systems: envelope (CloudEvents 1.0) + payload (JSON Schema / Avro / Protobuf), naming (past-tense domain.aggregate.action.v1), keys + ordering, versioning (additive / upcasting / parallel-topic), schema registry (Confluent / Apicurio), compatibility modes (backward / forward / full / none). Event types (fact vs delta, domain vs integration), idempotency keys, causation + correlation ids, PII handling. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
